RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 25

Raising the panel’s gender without concrete evidence of bias will appear adversarial and severely damage your professional reputation. An all-female panel alone does not indicate discrimination; it typically reflects organizational roles, reporting lines, or scheduling availability. 

For a "Head of" role, broad regulatory affairs expertise and leadership fit are often prioritized over statistical depth and academic credentials. Interview performance and strategic alignment are the most common deciding factors at this level.

Additionally, a two-week delay for written feedback is standard in corporate HR. Follow up politely, framing your inquiry purely around constructive feedback for your professional development. This maintains a positive relationship and keeps the door open for future opportunities.
